# InnerFormValidation

InnerFormValidation is a dependency-free JavaScript library for form validation, input masks, Brazilian documents, ViaCEP address autocomplete and geolocation.

## Canonical documentation
- https://zonaro.github.io/InnerFormValidation/docs/
- ../README.md

## Primary API
Load `InnerFormValidation.js`, then call `InnerFormValidation.validateCPF(value)`, `validateCNPJ`, `validateEmail`, `validDate`, `validateUF`, `validateOAB`, `validatePix`, `applyCPFMask(input)`, `applyCEPMask(input)`, `isValid(element, ...rules)`, `startMasks(element)` and `startValidation(element)`.

## jQuery compatibility
When jQuery is available, the same object is exposed as `$.innerForm` and legacy plugin methods remain available, including `isValid`, `startMasks`, `startValidation`, `validateOnBlur` and `validateOnType`.
